feeds.title: Spicy Southern Kitchen
feeds.description: Hi y'all! My name is Christin and I'm hopelessly addicted to collecting recipes and cooking. You'll find all kinds of recipes here, but many of them using fresh Southern produce (okra, peaches, sweet potatoes, corn, etc), and many of them spicy. I live in South Carolina with my husband and 2 teenage kids. I love all foods, but especially southern foods and spicy foods.

feeds.title: A Southern Soul Blog
feeds.description: Welcome! I'm Donya, a food and entertaining blogger with a distinctive Southern flair. I'm sharing delicious recipes and cooking tips along with home & garden DIY help to make your life perfectly wonderful!

feeds.title: Julias Simply Southern
feeds.description: Hey, Y'all! I am Julia. I grew up in South Carolina and love to share my tasty southern cooking blog posts, easy-to-follow recipes, and experiences with everyone.

feeds.title: Big Bear's Wife
feeds.description: Big Bears Wife is filled with tons of recipes that are easy to make and inspired by the south. You'll find easy dinner recipes, fun desserts and other favorites like slow cooker recipes, air fryer recipes and Instant Pot favorites. We also share our favorite travel spots, travel tips, party ideas and simple DIY craft directions!

feeds.title: Southern Bite
feeds.description: Father, Cookbook Author, and Southern food blogger sharing tried and true Southern recipes.

feeds.title: The Southern Lady Cooks Blog
feeds.description: The Southern Lady Cooks blog features great Southern recipes, tips, quotes, and all things Southern. Their mission is to share the joy of cooking. This website believes that Southern cooking is a labor of love and shares timeless favorites such as buttermilk biscuits.

feeds.title: Melissa's Southern Style Kitchen
feeds.description: Browse hundreds of the best tried and true Southern recipes ranging from tasty appetizers to decadent desserts. Melissa comes from a long line of fabulous Southern cooks, and like most people, her culinary training took place at the side of her Mom and Grandmothers. She is passionate about creating delicious dishes to share with family and friends.

feeds.title: Southern Plate
feeds.description: Here at Southern Plate, we provide a mix of Budget Friendly and Southern Recipes recipes to help you make your family and friends feel right at home.

feeds.title: Grits and Pinecones
feeds.description: Sharon creates delicious recipes with a Southern flair that are quick, easy and perfect to share with family and friends. She is blogger, recipe developer and photographer for Grits and Pinecones.

feeds.title: Grandbaby Cakes Blog
feeds.description: Jocelyn Delk Adams' food blog covers classic desserts and modern trends while highlighting the field of pastry and sweets.

feeds.title: Add a Pinch
feeds.description: Featuring family-friendly quick and easy meals, desserts, and more! Add a Pinch blog shares sweet, savory and southern recipes, as well as recipes perfect for fresh, delicious southern suppers! As a seventh generation southerner, Robyn learned to cook traditional southern favorites from her Mama and Grandmother.

feeds.title: The Seasoned Mom
feeds.description: From cozy casseroles to fresh salads and decadent desserts, you'll find hundreds of easy, family-friendly recipes straight from our Virginia farmhouse kitchen. A born-and-raised Virginian, Blair is a wife, mother of three, and busy home cook who shows love with food and enjoys feeding friends and family with the comforting dishes that she grew up on.

feeds.title: Joy the Baker
feeds.description: Joy shares recipes about sweet treats, savory indulgences, approachable recipes, and good-life inspiration. She is a self-taught baker, turned professional baker, turned food photographer, and three-time cookbook author. This has been her little corner of the internet since 2008.

feeds.title: Divas Can Cook
feeds.description: Learn to cook those soulful recipes from scratch by Monique. This site is chocked full of authentic Southern family recipes, recipes developed by her, and tweaked to perfection and a few non-traditional ones sprinkled throughout for good luck. She started Divas Can Cook back in 2009 when she noticed a shortage of authentic Southern recipes like the kind she grew up on, deep south, Elberton, GA cooking like authentic golden fried green tomatoes, hamburger steak and gravy, and forgotten tea cakes.

feeds.title: South Your Mouth
feeds.description: Original recipes and hilarious insights from award winning recipe creator and Southern food writer, Mandy Rivers.

feeds.title: Lana's Cooking
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Lana Stuart, the cook and author behind Lana's Cooking. I live in Georgia, in the southern U.S., with my very patient, taste-tester, and my husband Bill. I started Lana's Cooking in 2009 as a fun way to record some of the old, classic southern comfort food recipes that I grew up cooking with my mother, grandmothers, and aunts.

feeds.title: Sweet Life
feeds.description: Get rich and delicious texas recipes with a Latin twist by Vianney Rodriguez. She is an Award-Winning Food Blogger, Recipe Developer, and author of The Tex-Mex Slow Cooker and Latin Twist. Sweet Life is a celebration of that connection and the vibrant, unique culture of South Texas.

feeds.title: Feast + West
feeds.description: Feast + West is Susannah's blog where she writes about her cooking adventures. Here you'll find recipes, travel guides, and tips for cooking and entertaining to help you indulge in your life, too. Susannah Brinkley Henry is a graphic designer and a food & travel blogger based in Charlotte, N.C.

feeds.title: The Cooking Bride
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Lisa! On this blog, you'll find a mixture of traditional Southern recipes shared from my in-laws and a few of my creative updates on old classics. However, I've added two wild little boys into the mix, so there are a few quick and easy meals that can be prepared in between homework and after school activities.

feeds.title: Love & Olive Oil
feeds.description: Sharing delicious food and easy recipes for sweet desserts, easy dinners, creative canning, and more! The culinary adventures of Lindsay and Taylor. They share a love of cooking and found that it was much more enjoyable (and affordable!) for them to cook for themselves instead of going out to eat.

feeds.title: Pink Owl Kitchen
feeds.description: Pink Owl Kitchen is your go-to source for homemade recipes made with a touch of the South and a lot of love. You will find plenty of classic southern comfort food recipes, Cajun and Creole-inspired dishes, and just really good food. Let's eat!

feeds.title: Ronalyn T Alston Blog
feeds.description: am dedicated to helping families cook fresh and healthy recipes the easy way. My goal is to make family-friendly recipes that are delicious and filled with flavor. Never restrict your body to nutritious foods but gain a healthy balanced relationship with foods. Southern foods can be made healthy in so many different ways. I want to put the fun back into cooking again. Here you can find simplified recipes that don't sacrifice the taste or much of your time.

feeds.title: Syrup and Biscuits
feeds.description: Jackie Garvin is a cookbook author and publisher. Her Syrup and Biscuits is a Southern food blog that champions the best the South has to offer: simple food with modern and vintage recipes, beloved traditions, a focus on family, and bountiful gratitude for many blessings. Check out an array of Southern culinary traditions and ideas.

feeds.title: Southern FATTY
feeds.description: Phillip is a southern guy sharing tasty southern recipes and happiness.Loosen your bow tie, mint your julep and stop in for a bite to eat.

feeds.title: Supper With Michelle
feeds.description: My name is Michelle Braxton, the creator, recipe developer, and photographer of Supper with Michelle. I'm a firm believer in finding the right balance, in life and in the meals I prepare. I enjoy experimenting with various spices and ingredients and I try to incorporate as many fresh, seasonal, natural, and wholefood ingredients into my recipes whenever possible.

feeds.title: Bethcakes
feeds.description: Check out Beth's blog for recipes, sweet treats, baking adventures, and a little bit southern.

feeds.title: Southern Food Junkie
feeds.description: Southern Food Junkie brings you the best restaurants, food, and recipes from the South! It is all about the road trip to find the best and unique eateries in the South. They also share some of their favorite recipes or southern dishes along with doing reviews of unique foods and drinks.

feeds.title: Quiche My Grits
feeds.description: Quiche My Grits is a southern food blog that adds a touch of 'sass' to every meal. Find quick and easy recipes to make cooking fun!

feeds.title: Southern Kissed
feeds.description: Southern Kissed is a blog for all of your cooking needs. Whether you're looking for the perfect side dish, main course, or dessert, we have it! Follow along as Lynda shares articles on food and travel from a slightly southern perspective. She is a mom of 2 children & 2 dogs, wife of 1, and a messy cook taking life one bite at a time.

feeds.title: Cooking with K
feeds.description: Hi! I am Kay, publisher of Cooking with K. I love all things Southern and inspiring the next generation to enjoy cooking from recipes that have been passed down through the years. I have had a real passion for cooking that came to me through my Mother, Fern Sewell. You might say, my Southern cooking roots run deep in my style of cooking.

feeds.title: Deep South Dish
feeds.description: Find some of the favorite heirloom and heritage recipes that Mary grew up with and love so much. She serves up classic, old fashioned southern dishes from the Deep South, country cooking, southern plates of meat and, recipes the way her mama and grandma used to make them.
